minimal_candidate.scope: one server guest player in the existing guest_server_tick owner turn
minimal_candidate.suspension: accepted Inside, after visited insertion and original static dispatch, before native per-block tail
minimal_candidate.lower_crate: horizon-client-lib owns motion traversal; any cross-crate opaque frame interface must be explicit, private fields are not actor authority
minimal_candidate.upper_crate: horizon-client owns Game; private driver releases every MotionWorld/resource borrow before a real Game operation

continuation_obligations.requirement: The real current guest turn, body and admissible Ready lifecycle survive the operation; identical numeric ID, position and epoch are insufficient.
Define whether captured hit states and later live collision/context reads remain valid. The native snapshot assumes no block mutation below the sweep; unchanged actor alone is insufficient.
The state namespace, registry, shapes, collision and health resources retain the required owners/semantics; do not retain borrowed names across whole-Game mutation.
A pending native action is consumed exactly once, with native errors and outer ignored results preserved; no implicit retry/rollback.
Captured rules, movement, flags and later effect/pose/travel phases remain valid. Stopping only the inner sweep after a mutation does not specify the outer caller.
Per-instance curatives copy/update/hidden/save/cure semantics must be implemented natively before TConstruct protected fluid effects can activate.

cases.oracle: Both real crates compile; private frame fields/owned contact data; no cloned native types, reverse dependency or Game callback captured by static hook.
cases.failure_or_limit: Existing sequential borrow probe alone does not compile the new frame. Visibility must be established, not assumed pub(crate).

concrete_frontiers: LiveAttributes can create an instance by calling a boxed Identities FnMut. Native PlayerMotion::new supplies a counter, but public with_attribute_identities accepts a caller-supplied allocator; actual caller provenance is required.
PlayerEffects::modifiers visits the full existing list and status can reconcile stale caches even for an incoming poison/blindness effect or unchanged add result.
The inspected native Game bodies show no direct teleport/world-set call in this path; that limited observation is not a transitive installed-code invariant.
Arbitrary installed injections, state layout/constructor changes, imports/module method resolution, supplied callbacks and later lifecycle entry can invalidate this source-only slice.
No emitted complete-plan guard or actual mutation fixture is introduced by this inventory.
prospective_guard_rules: Freeze the COMPLETE selected installed plan, not just this ordinary library plan, and enumerate exact protected endpoints/dependencies first.

Reject or independently audit any hook kind/selector targeting a protected function, including call redirects/wraps/constants and return/head hooks; method name matching alone is only this bounded inventory.
Reject unreviewed state/constructor edits to EffectInstance, PlayerEffects, PotionState, PlayerMotion or relevant attribute/item data; same numeric body ID cannot make changed layout/ownership safe.

Review modules/import changes in owning namespaces and verify exact transformed function bodies plus the resolved dependency call graph; a same-file module is neither automatically forbidden nor automatically safe.
Preserve native ignored-error, full-list/cache update and callback order. Pre-admit only a proven narrow operation; do not run effects then invent continuation recovery.
